New Life Teen Challenge Development & Relief Program (NLTCDRP)

description.narrative: The Embassy of Finland has decided to award a discretionary government grant of EUR 35,000 to New Life Teen Challenge Development & Relief Program for empowering women & girls with disabilities through access to sexual and reproductive health rights (SRHR) in two selected Universities of Addis Abeba & Debre Berhan that covers 100% percent of the eligible costs of the project. The maximum amount of the December 2026 term. The application is turned down to the extent it exceeds the amount that is granted with this decision.
